lan-exp-003.text: Kenya is a country in East Africa, bordered by Somalia, Ethiopia, Tanzania, and South Sudan. Its capital is Nairobi, and it has three official languages: Swahili, English, and Arabic. Kenya gained independence from British colonial rule in 1963.
